# Vendored visual source

`../PatternWaves.tsx` and `../PatternWaves.css` derive from React Bits by David Haz:

- https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/ts-default/Backgrounds/PatternWaves/PatternWaves.tsx
- https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/ts-default/Backgrounds/PatternWaves/PatternWaves.css

Retrieved 14 November 2026. Retain [REACT-BITS-LICENSE.md](REACT-BITS-LICENSE.md), which includes MIT and the Commons Clause. These files ship as part of the Re::Source application, not as a standalone component product.

Local changes are documented in the component header and theme DESIGN.md. The `silk` shader and user-supplied configuration are preserved.
